findings.fix: Prove `isBigO_sub_inv_smul_residue` from the new lemma. Take `h` with `f = (s-ρ)⁻¹ • residue + h` on 𝓝[≠] ρ; then `f - (·-ρ)⁻¹ • residue =ᶠ h`, and `h` is `O(1)` because it is continuous at ρ (`hh.continuousAt.tendsto.isBigO_one ℂ` restricted to 𝓝[≠] ρ). Alternatively, keep only one of the two derivations.
findings.issue: `MeromorphicAt.exists_analyticAt_eventuallyEq_inv_smul_residue_add` repeats the opening of the existing `MeromorphicAt.isBigO_sub_inv_smul_residue`: the same `exists_analyticAt_eventuallyEq_zpow_smul` step, the same `hres` step and the same slope step. That leaves two parallel derivations of the regular part at an at-most-simple pole.

summary: The pole comparisons and the window-rate lemma are new, but the two helper lemmas copy proofs already written out in existing Tau Ceti code instead of replacing them. Rewrite the existing proofs to use the new lemmas.
